# PDFly by 3idhMinds

> Free universal PDF generator and REST API. Text/HTML to PDF in 70+ languages, image-to-PDF for 25+ formats, plus browser tools for merge, split, compress, and PDF-to-images. Web UI runs 100% client-side — your files never leave your browser. REST API for programmatic use with 1-hour auto-delete.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, features, and live demo.
- [PDF Generator App](/app): Web UI to generate PDFs from text using 15 templates.
- [Text to PDF](/text-to-pdf): Feature page for text/HTML to PDF conversion.
- [Image to PDF](/image-to-pdf): Feature page for converting images to PDF.
- [Convert Images](/images-to-pdf): Web UI to combine 100+ images into a single PDF.
- [Merge PDF](/merge-pdf): Free browser tool to combine multiple PDFs into one.
- [Split PDF](/split-pdf): Free browser tool to extract page ranges into separate PDFs.
- [Compress PDF](/compress-pdf): Free browser tool to reduce PDF file size.
- [PDF to Images](/pdf-to-images): Free browser tool to convert PDF pages to PNG/JPEG.

- [Pricing](/pricing): Free tier details and upcoming Pro plans.

## REST API endpoints

Base URL: `https://pdfly.3idhmind.in/api`

- `POST /generate-pdf` — Text/HTML to PDF (up to 5 documents per call).
- `POST /images-to-pdf` — Combine images into a PDF.
- `POST /merge-pdf` — Merge multiple PDFs into one.
- `POST /split-pdf` — Split a PDF by page ranges (e.g. `1-3,5,7-9`).
- `POST /compress-pdf` — Rewrite a PDF with metadata stripped and object streams for smaller size.
- `POST /pdf-to-images` — Return each page as a single-page PDF (for raster PNG/JPEG use the browser tool).
- `GET /get-documents` — List or fetch generated documents.

All endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer pdfgen_...` header. Generated files are auto-deleted within 1 hour.

## JavaScript SDK

```ts
import { PDFly } from "@pdfly/sdk";
const pdfly = new PDFly({ apiKey: "pdfgen_..." });
await pdfly.mergePdf({ pdfs: [url1, url2] });
```
